comment: C-first v11 case for zap.c:zapnodir(WAN_ENLIGHTENMENT). A fresh Wizard wishes for a wand of enlightenment, then selects it with #zap; C's NODIR dispatch reaches this distinct switch arm. C calls do_enlightenment_effect(), opens WIN_MESSAGE, prints its report and subsiding message, then exercises Wisdom. Keep only after a source-reaching C record, independent byte-identical rerecord, and comparison to the earlier wand cases.
